shows.name: The Rest Is History
shows.reason_cn: 历史顶流对谈；从中国史、冷战到科幻史都做，作者叙事强、信息密度高。
shows.desc_en: Take a deep dive into History’s biggest moments with Tom Holland & Dominic Sandbrook. Explore the stories of History’s most brutal rulers, deadly battles, and world-changing events. From the rise and fall of the Roman Empire, the Nazi conquest of Europe, and Hitler’s evil master plan for world domination, to the French Revolution, the sinking of the Titanic, or the Norman Conquest of England in 1066, Tom and Dominic bring the past to life with gripping storytelling and expert analysis, as they unpack the high-drama moments that shaped our world. Join The Rest Is History Club: Unlock the full experience of the show – with exclusive bonus episodes, ad-free listening, early access
shows.desc_cn: 与汤姆·霍兰德、多米尼克·桑德布鲁克一起潜入历史最重要的瞬间：最残暴的统治者、最惨烈的战役与改变世界的事件——从罗马帝国的兴衰、纳粹的征服到冷战，还原权力、阴谋与灾难未被切碎的故事。

shows.name: The Rest Is Politics
shows.reason_cn: 前工党幕僚长 × 前外交大臣的双视角时政拆解，全球议题与权力内幕。
shows.desc_en: Alastair Campbell and Rory Stewart break down current affairs in the UK and abroad. The Rest Is Politics analyses the latest international news, provides debate on global issues, and reveals secrets from Westminster, whilst bringing back the lost art of disagreeing agreeably. With insider perspectives and expert analysis, The Rest Is Politics is the go-to podcast for anyone seeking intelligent, engaging discussions on British and global politics. The Rest Is Politics Plus: Join with a FREE TRIAL at therestispolitics.com for exclusive bonus content including Rory and Alastair’s first ever miniseries, early access to episodes and live show tickets, ad free listening, our exclusive newsletter,
shows.desc_cn: 阿拉斯泰尔·坎贝尔与罗里·斯图尔特拆解英国及全球时政：分析最新国际新闻、辩论全球议题、揭示威斯敏斯特内幕，并复兴一度失传的辩论艺术。

shows.name: The Rest Is Politics: US
shows.reason_cn: 白宫视角的美国政治镜像版，与主节目互补。
shows.desc_en: TRIP US uncovers secrets from inside the White House inner circles as well as taking a wider look at the intricacies of United States society and how they shape the world's most important economy. The podcast is hosted by Anthony Scaramucci (The Mooch), former White House Director of Communications and Wall Street financier, and Katty Kay, US special correspondent for BBC who has been covering US politics for almost 30 years. Stay informed with in-depth discussions on key political events, policy changes, and the forces shaping America’s future on the global stage. New episodes released every Friday, or join our club for bonus content. Just head to https://therestispoliticsus.com t
shows.desc_cn: （本节目 Spotify 官方简介）揭露白宫核心圈内幕，并俯瞰美国社会肌理与世界最重要经济体的运转。主持：安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇与凯蒂·凯。

shows.name: The Rest Is Politics: Leading
shows.reason_cn: 领导人主题长访谈：权力、人生与领导力哲学。
shows.desc_en: The Rest Is Politics’ Alastair Campbell and Rory Stewart interview politicians, leaders, intellectuals, and more. From inside and outside of politics, guests join Rory and Alastair to discuss life, leadership, and the philosophy that’s led them to success in their chosen field. Their conversations cover key political events, global affairs, and the big ideas shaping the world today, offering listeners in-depth perspectives from those at the heart of change. The Rest Is Politics Plus: Become a member for exclusive bonus content, early access to Question Time episodes to live show tickets, ad-free listening for both TRIP and Leading, our exclusive newsletter, discount book prices on
shows.desc_cn: 《其余皆为政治》的延伸系列：坎贝尔与斯图尔特对话政治内外的领导人、知识分子等——从政治内部与外部，谈论人生、领导力，以及引领他们走到今日的那些哲学。

shows.name: The Rest Is Entertainment
shows.reason_cn: 影视/流媒体/奥斯卡产业内幕，聚会闲聊感十足的行业情报。
shows.desc_en: Richard Osman & Marina Hyde share insider knowledge on TV, movies, and pop culture. Stay up to date on what's hot and what's not in entertainment with behind-the-scenes insights from Richard and Marina. As two of the most connected voices in the business, they provide a unique perspective on the latest television series, film releases, and cultural trends. Their podcast explores everything from media gossip to industry secrets, giving listeners the inside track on the world of showbiz. Whether you're a fan of gritty dramas, blockbuster movies, or celebrity news, this podcast is your ultimate guide to entertainment. Richard and Marina offer fresh, expert analysis on the latest hits, star
shows.desc_cn: 理查德·奥斯曼与玛丽娜·海德分享电视、电影与流行文化的内幕知识：什么正热、什么过气，来自两位圈内消息最灵通声音的幕后洞察。

shows.name: The Rest Is Money
shows.reason_cn: 宏观经济/AI 就业/住房/债务——财经硬话题的通俗拆解。
shows.desc_en: Robert Peston and Steph McGovern bring you insightful business and finance stories. Join Robert Peston and Steph McGovern as they delve into the key challenges and opportunities facing today’s business world. From the complexities of tech investments to the impact of political decisions on global markets, this podcast offers valuable perspectives on current financial topics. Whether discussing business funding, economic policies, or corporate strategies, they provide listeners with the tools to understand today’s fast-evolving market. Each episode brings expert analysis on important issues, including market regulations, economic recovery, and the forces shaping the future of work. Robert and
shows.desc_cn: 罗伯特·佩斯顿与斯蒂芬·麦戈文带来精到的商业与金融故事：从科技投资到当下的关键挑战与机遇，拆解今天商业世界的复杂性。

shows.name: The Rest Is Classified
shows.reason_cn: 前 CIA 分析师 × 资深安全记者的真实谍报故事。
shows.desc_en: Enter the secretive world of spies, espionage, and covert operations. Hosted by former CIA analyst turned spy novelist, David McCloskey, and veteran security correspondent, Gordon Corera, this podcast unravels real-life spy stories, intelligence secrets, and the hidden power struggles shaping global events. From Cold War espionage to modern-day intelligence agencies like the CIA, MI6, and Mossad, explore the world of double agents, classified missions, and the shadowy figures who operate in them. Whether you're a true crime addict, a thriller fan, or fascinated by spy stories, this is the show for you.
shows.desc_cn: 走进间谍、谍报与秘密行动的隐秘世界。曾任中情局分析师、现为间谍小说家的大卫·麦克洛斯基与资深安全记者戈登·科雷拉共同还原真实谍报故事与情报战。

shows.name: Blank Check with Griffin & David
shows.reason_cn: 逐位导演全片单位长谈；作者论影迷的福音。
shows.desc_en: Not just another bad movie podcast, Blank Check reviews directors' complete filmographies episode to episode. Specifically, the auteurs whose early successes afforded them the rare ‘blank check’ from Hollywood to produce passion projects. Each new miniseries, hosts Griffin Newman and David Sims delve into the works of film’s most outsized personalities in painstakingly hilarious detail. Produced by Ben Hosley.
shows.desc_cn: 不止是又一个烂片播客：Blank Check 一集集回顾导演的完整作品目录——尤其是那些早期成功换来好莱坞'空白支票'、得以拍摄心血之作的作者导演。每一档系列都深入一位影史最张扬创作者的全部作品。

shows.name: The Film Comment Podcast
shows.reason_cn: 美国影评重刊官方播客，影评级深度。
shows.desc_en: Founded in 1962, Film Comment has been the home of independent film journalism for over 50 years, publishing in-depth interviews, critical analysis, and feature coverage of mainstream, art-house, and avant-garde filmmaking from around the world. The Film Comment Podcast, hosted by editors Devika Girish and Clinton Krute, is a weekly space for critical conversation about film, with a look at topical issues, new releases, and the big picture. Film Comment is a nonprofit publication that relies on the support of readers. Support film culture. Support Film Comment.
shows.desc_cn: 1962 年创刊的《电影评论》五十余年来一直是独立电影写作的家园：深度访谈、批评分析与对全球主流、艺术电影及先锋电影的长篇报道；播客延续这份批判传统。

shows.name: Pure Cinema Podcast
shows.reason_cn: 每周新片/老片/邪典/联映片单，补冷门利器。
shows.desc_en: A weekly film podcast hosted by Elric Kane (of the Shock Waves podcast) and Brian Saur (of the Rupert Pupkin Speaks film blog) featuring discussions of new films, old films, double features, cult movies, filmmakers and movie lists among a smorgasbord of other Cinema-related things.
shows.desc_cn: 每周电影播客，由（Shock Waves 的）埃里克·凯恩与（Rupert Pupkin Speaks 影评博客的）布莱恩·绍尔主持：新片、老片、双片连映、邪典电影、影人与片单一应俱全。

shows.name: The Cinephiliacs
shows.reason_cn: 学院派影评访谈；'ReWatch'重看经典环节极具价值。（官方简介未取到，此条为概述）
shows.desc_en: A Florida filmmaking podcast where we casually interview filmmakers and entertainers locally and from around the world.
shows.desc_cn: 影评人彼得·拉布扎主持的学院派电影对谈：'ReWatch' 环节逐场重看经典作品，并专访影史学者与批评家，硬核电影研究的播客版。

shows.name: New Books in Science, Technology, and Society
shows.reason_cn: STS 学者新书访谈频道，拉图尔/科学知识社会学的英文重镇。
shows.desc_en: This podcast is a channel on the New Books Network. The New Books Network is an academic audio library dedicated to public education. In each episode you will hear scholars discuss their recently published research with another expert in their field. Discover our 150+ channels and browse our 28,000+ episodes on our website: ⁠newbooksnetwork.com⁠ Subscribe to our free weekly Substack newsletter to get informative, engaging content straight to your inbox: ⁠https://newbooksnetwork.substack.com/⁠ Follow us on Instagram and Bluesky to learn about more our latest interviews: @newbooksnetwork Support our show by becoming a premium member! https://newbooksnetwork.supportingcast.fm/science-technology
shows.desc_cn: 新书网（New Books Network）旗下频道。新书网是一座致力于公共教育的学术音频图书馆；每期由学者与同行专家对谈他们新近发表的研究。

shows.name: Tech Won't Save Us
shows.reason_cn: 批判科技的政治经济学：数据中心、AI 与平台权力。
shows.desc_en: Governments are prioritizing data centers at the expense of communities and the planet, but it doesn’t have to be this way. Matt Haugen joins Paris Marx to discuss how national strategies are dismantling environmental protections while enriching a handful of megacorporations, and what an alternative agenda could look like. Matt Haugen is Research and Editorial Manager at the Climate and Community Institute. The podcast is made in partnership with The Nation. Production is by Kyla Hewson. Supp...
shows.desc_cn: 硅谷想塑造我们的未来，但我们凭什么让它这么做？每周四，巴黎·马克思与嘉宾一道批判性地审视科技产业、它的大承诺，以及背后的那些人。

shows.name: EconTalk
shows.reason_cn: 跨学科思想者访谈，科学哲学与 STS 味道浓。
shows.desc_en: EconTalk: Conversations for the Curious is an award-winning weekly podcast hosted by Russ Roberts of Shalem College in Jerusalem and Stanford's Hoover Institution. The eclectic guest list includes authors, doctors, psychologists, historians, philosophers, economists, and more. Learn how the health care system really works, the serenity that comes from humility, the challenge of interpreting data, how potato chips are made, what it's like to run an upscale Manhattan restaurant, what caused the 2008 financial crisis, the nature of consciousness, the conflicts and history of the Middle East, and more. EconTalk has been taking the Monday out of Mondays since 2006. All 1000+ episodes ar
shows.desc_cn: EconTalk：好奇者的对话（Conversations for the Curious），获奖周播节目，主持人是耶路撒冷沙勒姆学院与斯坦福胡佛研究所的罗斯·罗伯茨。嘉宾名单横跨作家、医生、心理学家、历史学家与哲学家。

shows.name: Philosophy Bites
shows.reason_cn: 15 分钟哲学访谈，通勤友好；与哲学大家直接对话。
shows.desc_en: David Edmonds (Uehiro Centre, Oxford University) and Nigel Warburton (freelance philosopher/writer) interview top philosophers on a wide range of topics. Two books based on the series have been published by Oxford University Press. We are currently self-funding - donations very welcome via our website http://www.philosophybites.com
shows.desc_cn: 牛津大学（上广中心）大卫·埃德蒙兹与自由哲学家奈杰尔·沃伯顿访谈顶级哲学家，话题覆盖广泛；以此系列为基础已出版两本牛津大学出版社著作。

shows.name: The Partially Examined Life
shows.publisher: Mark Linsenmayer, Wes Alwan, Seth Paskin, Dylan Casey
shows.reason_cn: 几位'想开了'的哲学博士逐段精读原著。
shows.desc_en: The Partially Examined Life is a podcast by some guys who were at one point set on doing philosophy for a living but then thought better of it. Each episode, we pick a short text and chat about it with some balance between insight and flippancy. You don't have to know any philosophy, or even to have read the text we're talking about to (mostly) follow and (hopefully) enjoy the discussion. For links to the texts we discuss and other info, check out www.partiallyexaminedlife.com. We also feature episodes from other podcasts by our hosts to round out your partially examined life, including Pretty Much Pop (prettymuchpop.com, covering all media), Nakedly Examined Music (nakedlyexaminedmusic.com,
shows.desc_cn: 一档由几位曾经立志以哲学为业、后来'想开'了的人制作的播客。每期挑一小段文本，在洞见与插科打诨之间围绕它深聊；不需要哲学背景也能跟上。

shows.name: History of Philosophy Without Any Gaps
shows.reason_cn: 按年代'无缝'走完整个哲学史，治史系哲学家的选择。
shows.desc_en: Peter Adamson, Professor of Philosophy at the LMU in Munich and at King’s College London, takes listeners through the history of philosophy, ”without any gaps.” The series looks at the ideas, lives and historical context of the major philosophers as well as the lesser-known figures of the tradition. www.historyofphilosophy.net. NOTE: iTunes shows only the most recent 300 episodes; subscribe on iTunes or go to a different platform for the whole series.
shows.desc_cn: 慕尼黑 LMU 与伦敦国王学院哲学教授彼得·亚当森带你'没有一丝缝隙'地走完哲学史：考察各大哲学家的思想、生平与时代语境。

shows.name: Between the Covers
shows.reason_cn: 当代文学深度访谈；作家常客是村上、石黑、韩江级。
shows.desc_en: BOOKS ∙ WORKSHOPS ∙ PODCAST
shows.desc_cn: 作家大卫·奈蒙主持的著名文学播客：与今日最富活力的思想家进行慷慨而深入的文学对话，照亮当代写作的复杂性。

shows.name: Geek's Guide to the Galaxy
shows.reason_cn: 科幻作家访谈殿堂：特德·姜、尼尔·盖曼级嘉宾。
shows.desc_en: Ad-free episodes are available to our paid supporters over at patreon.com/geeks Host David Barr Kirtley, author of the book Save Me Plz and Other Stories, talks geek culture with guests such as Neil Gaiman, George R. R. Martin, Margaret Atwood, Richard Dawkins, Simon Pegg, Amanda Knox, Andrew Yang, Joyce Carol Oates, Neil deGrasse Tyson, and Ursula K. Le Guin. Geek’s Guide to the Galaxy has appeared on recommended podcast lists from NPR, The Guardian, Wired, The A.V. Club, BBC America, CBC Radio, WVXU, io9, Omni, The Strand, Library Journal, and Popular Mechanics. CBC Radio writes, "You may not think a podcast about science fiction and fantasy would be the place to go for political ins
shows.desc_cn: 主持人、作家大卫·巴尔·柯特利与尼尔·盖曼、乔治·R·R·马丁、玛格丽特·阿特伍德等嘉宾畅谈极客文化——科幻与流行文化访谈的旗舰节目。

shows.name: The Paris Review
shows.reason_cn: 文学季刊最佳访谈/小说/诗歌的有声化。
shows.desc_en: The Paris Review Podcast returns with a new season, featuring the best interviews, fiction, essays, and poetry from America’s most legendary literary quarterly, brought to life in sound. Join us for intimate conversations with Sharon Olds and Olga Tokarczuk; fiction by Rivers Solomon, Jun'ichirō Tanizaki, and Zach Williams; poems by Terrance Hayes and Maggie Millner; nonfiction by Robert Glück, Jean Garnett, and Sean Thor Conroe; and performances by George Takei, Lena Waithe, and many others. Catch up on earlier seasons, and listen to the trailer for Season 4 now. ]]>
shows.desc_cn: 《巴黎评论》播客带来美国最传奇文学季刊的最佳访谈、小说、随笔与诗歌，以声音重现；与莎伦·欧茨、奥尔加·托卡尔丘克等人的亲密交谈。

shows.name: Backlisted
shows.reason_cn: 每一集介绍一本被时代遗忘的好书（英式扎实书话）。
shows.desc_en: The literary podcast that has been giving new life to old books since 2015. For show notes visit backlisted.fm and get an extra two shows a month by supporting the pod at patreon.com/backlisted
shows.desc_cn: 自 2015 年起让老书重获新生的文学播客。节目笔记见 backlisted.fm，并可通过 Patreon 支持获取每月额外两期节目。

shows.name: Dan Snow's History Hit
shows.reason_cn: 每日历史档，二战/中世纪/冷战选题密集。
shows.desc_en: Historian Dan Snow journeys across the globe to tell the stories of history's defining moments. From the Colosseum in Rome to the Great Wall of China, the battlefields of Waterloo to the Tomb of Tutankhamun, join Dan as he explores the how and why of the greatest monuments, battles, heroes, villains and events that have shaped our world. New episodes on Mondays and Thursdays with bonus subscriber only episodes every other Friday. You can get in touch with us at ds.hh@historyhit.com <br&g
shows.desc_cn: 历史学家丹·斯诺走遍全球讲述历史的决定性时刻：从罗马斗兽场到中国长城，从滑铁卢战场到图坦卡蒙墓。

shows.name: Long Now
shows.reason_cn: 长期主义思想演讲：技术哲学、文明尺度。
shows.desc_en: The Long Now Foundation is a non-profit dedicated to fostering long-term thinking and responsibility. Explore hundreds of lectures and conversations from scientists, historians, artists, entrepreneurs, and more through The Long Now Foundation's award-winning Long Now Talks, started in 02003 by Long Now co-founder Stewart Brand (creator of the Whole Earth Catalog). Past speakers include Brian Eno, Neal Stephenson, Jenny Odell, Daniel Kahneman, Suzanne Simard, Jennifer Pahlka, Kim Stanley Robinson, and many more. Watch video of these talks at https://longnow.org/talks
shows.desc_cn: 长期现在基金会是一家致力于培育长期思考与责任的非营利机构：数百场科学家、历史学家、艺术家与企业家的讲座与对话。

shows.name: The LRB Podcast
shows.reason_cn: 深度书评与观念批评的英音权威。
shows.desc_cn: （Spotify 页面未能机器核验，采用站内搜索直达）《伦敦书评》杂志的播客：评书、评观念，英国书评界最锋利的声音之一。

shows.name: Sinica Podcast
shows.reason_cn: 英文世界看中国的深度访谈节目。
shows.desc_cn: （官方简介概要）SupChina 旗下深度中国政治与社会访谈节目，由资深媒体人郭恺（Kaiser Kuo）主持/出品。

shows.name: The Candid Frame
shows.reason_cn: 摄影访谈：每位摄影师谈自己的创作与观看。
shows.desc_cn: （官方简介概要）摄影师访谈节目：与来自不同领域的摄影师对话，探讨他们的创作实践、想法与观看方式。

shows.name: The Video Archives Podcast with Quentin Tarantino & Roger Avary
shows.cn_name: 录像档案播客（昆汀·塔伦蒂诺 × 罗杰·艾弗里）
shows.reason_cn: 昆汀·塔伦蒂诺与罗杰·艾弗里重刷当年打工的录像店库存：不是影评，是两个奥斯卡编剧把 B 级片当作者论讲。
shows.desc_en: FULL, AD FREE EPISODES ON PATREON.COM/VIDEOARCHIVES Quentin Tarantino & Roger Avary invite you to become a customer at Video Archives, the video store where it all began. Joined by their trusty producer Gala Avary, they'll travel back in time to revisit old classics and discover new favorites, pulled from the thousands of actual VHS tapes that Quentin & Roger used to recommend to customers back in the day at the ori…
shows.desc_cn: 昆汀·塔伦蒂诺与罗杰·艾弗里邀请你成为 Video Archives 录像店的顾客——这家店正是他们电影生涯的起点。两人与制片人加拉·艾弗里一起，从店里数万盘录像带中挑片重看、闲聊争论。

shows.name: You Must Remember This
shows.cn_name: 你是否还记得（好莱坞秘史）
shows.reason_cn: 好莱坞头一百年的秘史正传：曼森、黑名单、梦露——考据型影史叙事的天花板。
shows.desc_en: You Must Remember This is a storytelling podcast exploring the secret and/or forgotten histories of Hollywood’s first century. It’s the brainchild and passion project of Karina Longworth (founder of Cinematical.com, former film critic for LA Weekly), who writes, narrates, records and edits each episode. It is a heavily-researched work of creative nonfiction: navigating through conflicting reports, mythology, and ins…
shows.desc_cn: 由 Karina Longworth 打造的叙事型播客，探索好莱坞第一个百年的秘密与被遗忘的历史：明星、丑闻、审查与权力。

shows.name: Filmspotting
shows.reason_cn: 2005 年开播的影评常青树：新片评论 + Top 5 片单，美国影评播客的制度性存在。
shows.desc_en: Adam Kempenaar and Josh Larsen review new and classic movies, offering "affable, insightful film analysis since 2005" (NY Times).
shows.desc_cn: Adam Kempenaar 与 Josh Larsen 评论新片与经典，《纽约时报》称其“自 2005 年以来和蔼而洞明的电影分析”。

shows.name: Screen Drafts
shows.reason_cn: 影评人轮流选秀建“最佳片单”：库布里克、科恩兄弟、1999……游戏机制里藏着正典社会学。
shows.desc_en: Experts and enthusiasts competitively collaborate in the creation of screen-centric "best of" lists. Hosted by draft commissioners Clay Keller and Ryan Marker. "Most impeccable taste in guests." - Entertainment Weekly
shows.desc_cn: 专家与发烧友竞争性合作，围绕电影主题构建“最佳”榜单；由选秀专员 Clay Keller 与 Ryan Marker 主持。

shows.name: Team Deakins
shows.reason_cn: 摄影大师 Roger Deakins 夫妇的对谈节目：导演、演员、摄影指导轮流进直播间，谈手艺不谈八卦。
shows.desc_en: The Team Deakins podcast is an ongoing conversation between acclaimed cinematographer Roger Deakins and James Deakins, his collaborator, about cinematography, the film business and whatever other questions are submitted. We start with a specific question and end....who knows where! We are joined by guests periodically. Followup questions can be posted in the forums at www.rogerdeakins.com.
shows.desc_cn: 著名摄影指导 Roger Deakins 与合作者 James Deakins 的持续对谈：聊摄影、电影行业与听众提交的各种问题。

shows.name: The New Yorker: Fiction
shows.reason_cn: 作家读《纽约客》档案里的老故事并细谈——文学批评以“朗读+对读”的形式发生。
shows.desc_en: A monthly reading and conversation with the New Yorker fiction editor Deborah Treisman.
shows.desc_cn: 每月一期：《纽约客》小说编辑 Deborah Treisman 邀请一位作家朗读杂志档案中的一篇短篇小说，并交谈背后的写作。

shows.name: Bookworm
shows.reason_cn: Michael Silverblatt 主持三十余年的文学访谈传奇：莫里森、石黑一雄、桑德斯都曾坐进他的录音间。
shows.desc_en: Intellectual, accessible, and provocative literary conversations.
shows.desc_cn: 智性、可亲而尖锐的文学对谈——KCRW 旗舰文学节目。

shows.name: Literary Friction
shows.reason_cn: 文学经纪人 × 学者双主持：每期一个主题（约束/女性主义/亲密）配一位作家深访，批评味最足的当代文学节目。
shows.desc_en: A monthly conversation about books and ideas on NTS Radio hosted by friends Carrie Plitt, a literary agent, and Octavia Bright, a writer and academic. Each show features an author interview, book recommendations, lively discussion and a little music too, all built around a related theme - anything from the novella to race to masculinity. Listen live on NTS Radio www.nts.live
shows.desc_cn: NTS Radio 上的月更读书节目：文学经纪人 Carrie Plitt 与作家学者 Octavia Bright 每期采访一位作家并给出主题书单。

shows.name: In Our Time: Culture
shows.reason_cn: Melvyn Bragg 召集三位学者四十五分钟讲透一个文化正典条目：《米德尔马契》《第七封印》都是一堂课。
shows.desc_en: Popular culture, poetry, music and visual arts and the roles they play in our society.
shows.desc_cn: 大众文化、诗歌、音乐与视觉艺术，以及它们在社会中的角色——BBC Radio 4 旗舰讨论节目的文化线。

shows.name: A Small Voice: Conversations with photographers and filmmakers
shows.reason_cn: Ben Smith 主持的英国摄影深访双周刊：从大师到新人都聊人生与过程，Stephen Shore 第 192 期是入门首选。
shows.desc_en: Fortnightly in-depth interviews featuring a diverse range of talented, innovative, world-class photographers from established, award-winning and internationally exhibited stars to young and emerging talents discussing their lives, work and process with fellow photographer, Ben Smith.
shows.desc_cn: 摄影师 Ben Smith 每两周一期的深度访谈：从获奖大师到新兴人才，聊生活、作品与创作过程。

shows.name: PhotoWork with Sasha Wolf - Photography Podcast
shows.cn_name: 摄影作品（Sasha Wolf 访谈）
shows.reason_cn: 摄影书出版人 Sasha Wolf 的职业向深访：Alec Soth、Ocean Vuong、Mitch Epstein 都来聊'如何以摄影为生'。
shows.desc_en: PhotoWork with Sasha Wolf is a photography podcast produced by the PhotoWork Foundation, featuring in-depth interviews with photographers, curators, and publishers. Episodes explore photobooks, artistic practice, long-term projects, and fine art photography today.
shows.desc_cn: PhotoWork 基金会出品的摄影播客：与摄影师、策展人、出版人深谈摄影书、艺术实践与长期项目。

shows.name: A brush with...
shows.cn_name: 艺术之笔（Art Newspaper 艺术家自述）
shows.reason_cn: Ben Luke 请艺术家自述影响图谱：从文学音乐到美术馆，Tillmans、Kentridge、Thomas Ruff 都做过客。
shows.desc_en: A brush with..., sponsored by Bloomberg Connects, is a podcast by The Art Newspaper that features in-depth conversations with leading international artists. Host Ben Luke asks the questions you've always wanted to: who are the artists, historical and contemporary, they most admire?
shows.desc_cn: 《艺术新闻》播客：Ben Luke 与国际顶尖艺术家深谈他们最崇拜的艺术家、常去的美术馆、启发他们的书与音乐——以及'艺术为了什么'。

shows.name: Talk Art
shows.reason_cn: 演员 Russell Tovey × 画廊主 Robert Diament 的每周艺术闲谈：名人嘉宾入场门槛最低的当代艺术入口。
shows.desc_en: Talk Art is a podcast released every week by actor Russell Tovey and gallerist Robert Diament, featuring accessible and entertaining conversations with artists, museum directors, collectors and celebrities about art and why it matters.
shows.desc_cn: 演员 Russell Tovey 与画廊主 Robert Diament 每周更新：与艺术家、馆长、藏家和名人轻松聊艺术为何重要。

shows.name: The Art Angle
shows.reason_cn: Artnet 新闻部每周把艺术圈最大新闻讲成人话：市场、博物馆、丑闻与趋势的一手内幕。
shows.desc_en: A weekly podcast that brings the biggest stories in the art world down to earth. Go inside the newsroom of the art industry's most-read media outlet, Artnet News, for an in-depth view of what matters most in museums, the market, and much more.
shows.desc_cn: 每周一期，走进艺术行业读者最多的新闻编辑部：博物馆、市场与大事记的深度拆解。

shows.name: The Messy Truth - Conversations on Photography
shows.reason_cn: 图片总监 Gem Fletcher 拆解行业里没人说的部分：Catherine Opie、Charlotte Cotton、Laia Abril 都来交底。
shows.desc_en: Photo Director Gem Fletcher hosts The Messy Truth, a podcast dedicated to the world of contemporary photography featuring exclusive interviews with emerging and leading artists, curators and critics.
shows.desc_cn: 图片总监 Gem Fletcher 主持：与当代摄影的新锐与领军艺术家、策展人、批评家坦诚对谈， unpack 图像如何塑造世界。

shows.name: Right Eye Dominant
shows.reason_cn: 摄影师 Nick Tauro Jr. 的个人摄影课堂：Robert Frank 百期特辑、Burtynsky、Lev Manovich 谈 AI 时代的模拟记忆。
shows.desc_en: A photography-focused podcast that delves into the creative process, and the trials and tribulations of bringing lasting value to your artwork, regardless of the medium.
shows.desc_cn: 聚焦创作过程的摄影播客：创作者访谈、自出版zine、伟大摄影书、展览与被忽视的英雄。

shows.name: Analog Talk
shows.reason_cn: 胶片复兴一线的社区播客：Alec Soth 第 154 期之外，大画幅、宝丽来、中国胶片生态都有专集。
shows.desc_en: A film photography podcast.
shows.desc_cn: 一档胶片摄影播客。

shows.name: ARE WE ON AIR ?
shows.cn_name: 我们开播了吗（文化名流原声）
shows.reason_cn: 文化推手 Arman Naféei 探访全球文化名人的'人生原声'：Tillmans 那期从宇宙聊到俱乐部文化。
shows.desc_en: Are We On Air ? is a weekly interview series by Arman Naféei exploring the life's soundtrack of global cultural figures and personalities within the fields of music, film, art, fashion, life and culture.
shows.desc_cn: Arman Naféei 的每周访谈系列：探索音乐、电影、艺术、时尚领域全球文化人物的'人生配乐'。

shows.name: Future of StoryTelling (FoST)
shows.reason_cn: 讲故事的科学：Stephen Shore 两度做客谈'照片与故事'——影像叙事的最佳交叉点。
shows.desc_en: The Future of StoryTelling (FoST) is a passionate community of people from the worlds of media, technology, and communications who believe that better stories can create a better world.
shows.desc_cn: FoST 是由媒体、科技与传播界组成的社群，相信更好的故事能创造更好的世界；播客访谈叙事前沿的实践者。

shows.name: Emulsions Podcast
shows.reason_cn: 年轻一代的胶片播客：Stephen Shore 2023/2025 两度长访，谈 Uncommon Places 之后的人生。
shows.desc_en: Film photography podcast from Stephen K. Schuster and Hollis Monk Thayer.
shows.desc_cn: Stephen K. Schuster 与 Hollis Monk Thayer 主持的胶片摄影播客。

shows.name: Thought Pieces
shows.reason_cn: 摄影书名社 MACK 官方播客：作者亲读自己的艺术写作——Stephen Shore 读《Modern Instances》是代表集。
shows.desc_en: Thought Pieces, the podcast from celebrated publisher MACK, brings you the best of arts writing across literature, poetry and criticism. Each week, discover a new piece of writing, read by the artist or writer themself.
shows.desc_cn: 著名出版社 MACK 的播客：汇集文学、诗歌与批评领域的最佳艺术写作，每周由作者本人朗读一篇。

shows.name: New Books in Sociology
shows.reason_cn: 社会学家亲自讲自己的新书：科技劳工、阶层再生产、数字资本主义……NBN 旗下社会学正统频道。
shows.desc_en: Interviews with sociologists about their new books, covering inequality, culture, technology, migration, education and the full breadth of the discipline.
shows.desc_cn: New Books Network 社会学频道：每期由学者访谈同行，讨论其新近出版的研究专著。

shows.name: Social Science Bites
shows.reason_cn: Philosophy Bites 团队打造：David Edmonds 每集 15 分钟采访一位顶尖社会科学家——Lamont 论污名即在此。
shows.desc_en: In this series of illuminating podcasts, hear Dave Edmonds interview leading social scientists to learn their perspectives on how our social world is created, and how social science can help us understand people and how they behave.
shows.desc_cn: Dave Edmonds 采访顶尖社会科学家：听他们讲社会世界如何被建构、社会科学如何帮助我们理解人与行为。

shows.name: Talking About Organizations Podcast
shows.cn_name: 漫谈组织（组织理论精读）
shows.reason_cn: 逐本精读组织研究经典：第 67/109 期整两期精读 Andrew Abbott《The System of Professions》——分形区分作者的另一场重头戏。
shows.desc_en: Talking About Organizations is a conversational podcast where we talk about one book, journal article or idea per episode and try to understand it, its purpose and its impact.
shows.desc_cn: 每周精读一本组织理论/管理科学经典：理解它的目的与影响，从韦伯到梅奥到当代。

shows.name: give theory a chance
shows.reason_cn: The Society Pages 出品的社会理论播客：把经典理论与当下议题接通，课堂级的理论对谈。
shows.desc_en: A podcast about social theory from The Society Pages, featuring conversations with theorists about theory and its uses.
shows.desc_cn: The Society Pages 旗下的社会理论播客：与理论家对话，聊理论及其用途。

shows.name: Uncommon Sense
shows.reason_cn: 《社会学评论》基金会官方播客：英国社会学界的公共声音，主题从算法社会到气候正义。
shows.desc_en: Uncommon Sense is the podcast from The Sociological Review Foundation, expanding what it means to be sociological through conversations with researchers, writers and artists.
shows.desc_cn: 《社会学评论》基金会的播客：通过与研究者、作家、艺术家的对话，拓展'社会学的想象力'的边界。
